svg.aria-label: The changes view: what it is made of
svg.title: The changes view: what it is made of

g.text: The changes view: what it is made of: LouisAgent.Packs.Git.Web, Views / GitChangesView
Who puts it on a page
what git says, and whether it
a prompt for the chat, waiting
review each changed file, tick some, then act on them
Changes, the same for what isn't staged
one file's diff, with old and new line numbers
A box inside a box is held by it.

text.tspan: The view holds the list of what changed beside the diff that's open; a group's files are ticked and staged, unstaged, discarded or committed, and a review goes to the chat.
